Throughout 2024 and 2025, Russian state-owned plants worked under a strict delivery schedule for an export contract designated K-10. Russian documents use both K-10 and K10, depending on the plant. According to one of the documents published below, K-10 is the designation used by Russia's defence industry for Iran.
